result.note: Tests India's June 2026 Seychelles package, the 2015 Seychelles base setback and the July 2026 India–Japan defence co-development pact.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about Prime Minister Modi's visit to Seychelles in June 2026:
items: The visit coincided with Seychelles' 50th independence day.
India extended a line of credit of USD 300 million to Seychelles.
India gifted a patrol vessel, and the package included rollouts of UPI and generic medicines.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the line of credit was USD 130 million, alongside eight agreements signed during the visit. None of the package needs a parliamentary vote in Seychelles, which makes it harder to reverse than a base lease.
questions.source: Modi visited Seychelles for its 50th independence day, signing eight agreements, extending a USD 130 million line of credit, and gifting a patrol vessel, with UPI and generic-medicine rollouts as the civilian anchors.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the India–Japan summit held in July 2026:
items: Prime Minister Modi met Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.
The two countries signed their first defence co-development pact.
A target was set to send 500 Indian AI professionals to Japan by 2030.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three statements are correct. Modi and Takaichi signed the first defence co-development pact and set the AI professionals target. They also signed documents on economic security, energy and artificial intelligence between the two QUAD partners.
questions.source: Modi and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi signed India and Japan's first defence co-development pact, alongside documents on economic security, energy, and artificial intelligence, and a target to send 500 Indian AI professionals to Japan by 2030.

questions.prompt: An Indian military-base plan collapsed in 2015 in the parliament of which Indian Ocean country?
questions.explain: The 2015 base plan collapsed in the Seychelles parliament. India's June 2026 package of credit, a patrol vessel, UPI and generic medicines was designed so that none of it needed a parliamentary vote.
questions.source: After a 2015 military-base plan collapsed in the Seychelles parliament, the genius of this package is that none of it needs a parliamentary vote.
